advisory.finding: test_adr_0063_records_the_local_failure_boundary_reargument asserts verbatim ADR narrative prose phrases ('adds no fetcher', 'no page bodies', 'never manufacture prior art', 'turn a block into a pass') from a human-facing documentation file. No non-human consumer (parser/validator/registry/CI) branches on these exact phrases, so the test breaks on any behavior-preserving rewording of the ADR with no observable-behavior change — a change-detector on author wording rather than a structural-contract assertion.

dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Distinguish the rebar-issued WEB_SEARCH_UNAVAILABLE sentinel from spoofable upstream results (e.g. an out-of-band flag or per-run nonce) so untrusted search data cannot forge the failure notice.
evidence: capabilities.py:143-148 constructs the sentinel with fixed, guessable string fields: `"title": _WEB_SEARCH_UNAVAILABLE_TITLE, "href": "", ...`

plan_review_T1.md rubric: 'a rebar-issued local-tool failure notice ONLY when the result list holds exactly one record, title exactly `WEB_SEARCH_UNAVAILABLE`, and href exactly `""`; its only authority is to make prior art UNVERIFIED.'
ADR 0063 line 11-13 establishes local-route results are UNTRUSTED third-party data fetched by our process; nothing prevents an upstream result from populating title/href with the sentinel values.
Ticket 91af-c8d0-201a-4eec 'Alternatives' explicitly rejected 'Per-run nonce - extra model-visible mechanism', so the sentinel carries no unforgeable marker.

REACHABILITY / BLAST RADIUS: the forged sentinel's only granted authority is 'prior art UNVERIFIED', which can only weaken a T1 conclusion, never manufacture prior art or turn a BLOCK into a PASS — a spoof is fail-safe, not privilege-gaining.
dropped.finding: The T1 failure sentinel is discriminated only by in-band, model-visible fields (a single-record result with title exactly `WEB_SEARCH_UNAVAILABLE` and href exactly `""`), which are values that UNTRUSTED upstream DuckDuckGo results could themselves carry — letting a crafted search result forge the rebar-issued failure notice the rubric grants special authority to.
scenarios: A page indexed by DuckDuckGo returns a single result whose title is 'WEB_SEARCH_UNAVAILABLE' and empty href, causing the reviewer to treat a genuine (available) search as a rebar tool failure and mark prior art UNVERIFIED.
